pages.text: A mat occupies three consecutive slots in one column. Use an empty slot with a mat; it extends $(bold)toward the front$(reset) and requires three clear slots. Use any part of the mat to try sleeping.$(br2)Stop the wagon and avoid excessive tilt before entering sleep. Moving afterward does not wake sleeping players or maids.

Mats follow normal sleeping conditions but $(bold)do not set a respawn point$(reset). They only work in bed-compatible dimensions. The Nether and End reject use without an explosion.$(br2)Sneak-use to remove a mat. Removal wakes its sleeper safely. Block-to-entity conversion preserves sleep; sleepers may still obstruct conversion back to blocks.

pages.heading: book.tm_wagon.recipe
pages.text: Use any planks, including modded planks. Mats have no wood variants.
